faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.description: Questions about APPI programmes, engagement, and the secretariat.
faq.q1: What is the African Political Parties Initiative (APPI)?
faq.a1: APPI is a continental platform that supports political party reform, stronger democratic institutions, and inclusive leadership. It connects parties, partners, and experts through summits, learning programmes, and country-level reform dialogues.
faq.q2: How can my organisation engage with APPI?
faq.a2: Start by contacting the secretariat through the contact page. Teams can join dialogues, co-design programmes, sponsor learning tracks, or propose country-level collaboration aligned with APPI’s mandate.
faq.q3: Where are APPI events and programmes held?
faq.a3: Flagship gatherings and regional activities are announced on the summit and insights pages. Many activities are hybrid or rotated across member states to reflect continental representation.
faq.q4: How does APPI approach inclusion and gender?
faq.a4: Inclusive leadership is a cross-cutting priority. APPI designs formats, quotas, and facilitation so youth, women, and under-represented groups shape agendas—not only participate in them.
